overview: The Medford City Council met to set FY23 property tax classification factors, discuss utility paving concerns on Winthrop Street, address school safety and governance, and vote on several municipal resolutions and licenses.

items.title: MHS Football Team Recognition
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting the Medford High School head football coach and team to an upcoming meeting to receive citations for community outreach.

items.title: FY23 Property Tax Classification Hearing
items.summary: The Council set FY23 property tax parameters by adopting a minimum residential factor of 91.43 and voting against adopting a residential exemption, small commercial exemption, or open space discount.

items.title: Eversource Winthrop Street Paving Discussion
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting field engineer contact details on the city website and a commitment from Eversource to finish Winthrop Street paving before the school year or provide monthly updates.

items.title: Off-Leash Dogs Survey Process
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting information from the administration regarding the creation and process behind a public survey on off-leash dog hours in city parks.

items.title: City Hall Beautification Day
items.summary: Approved a resolution to coordinate a City Hall beautification day between the council and city administration.

items.title: KP Law Expenses and Legal Services Report
items.summary: Passed an amended resolution requesting the Finance Director present quarterly reports, warrant articles, and legal expenditure data for FY20 through FY23 at the December 20 meeting.

items.title: Communication with City Partners
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Chief of Staff attend an upcoming meeting to discuss improving inter-departmental communication regarding major incidents and events.

items.title: November General Election After-Action Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an after-action report from the Elections Manager and Elections Commission regarding the November general election.

items.title: Camp Lejeune Water Contamination Hotline
items.summary: Passed an amended resolution requesting information regarding the Camp Lejeune water contamination lawsuit and local support resources be published on the Veteran Services website.

items.title: Police Department Information Sessions
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Medford Police Department reinstate monthly traveling neighborhood information sessions.

items.title: Parking Department and Traffic Commission Information Sessions
items.summary: Passed an amended resolution requesting the Parking Department and Traffic Commission implement monthly traveling neighborhood information sessions.

items.title: Report on High School Student Violence
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a report from the Medford High School School Resource Officer detailing student violence incidents and complaints over the past 24 months.

items.title: Workers' Compensation Sick Leave Ordinance Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a draft ordinance allowing city employees receiving workers' compensation benefits to use accrued leave time to maintain full pay.

items.title: Public Schools Accountability Ordinance Proposal
items.summary: The Council referred a proposed ordinance mandating monthly School Committee listening sessions to the Committee of the Whole, while passing a substitute resolution requesting a supplemental budget appropriation for school safety and mental health resources.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Life Cafe
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for LTF Club Operations Company, Inc., doing business as Life Cafe at 70 Station Landing.
